description: The exact DNS records to add so a domain serves a website (Vercel, Netlify, GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages) and receives email (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Fastmail, Zoho, Proton), plus a starting DMARC policy. Checks live DNS to show which records are already in place and warns about clashes such as two SPF records. Values a provider generates per account are marked as such.

account.description: GitHub user, Netlify site or Cloudflare Pages project name, when the website host needs one

name: dns_setup
title: DNS records for a website and email
